name: Gestao Hospital
description: The project aims to develop a Hospital Management System designed to organize and optimize resources within a public health system. The system addresses the challenge of managing a large and complex public health infrastructure, such as Brazil's Unified Health System (SUS), by providing a tool to prevent waste and maximize resource utilization, particularly in patient care.The system manages hospitals, each equipped with an inventory of various products, including a blood bank, and a specific number of beds. Its core functionalities include registering hospitals, recommending the closest hospital with available beds to a patient based on their location, and facilitating patient check-in and check-out processes. It also allows users to monitor available beds, register and manage product quantities in hospital stock, and oversee blood bank resources. A key feature is the ability to coordinate the transfer of necessary products, such as blood, from the nearest available hospital, while ensuring that each hospital retains a minimum stock for its own immediate needs.

transplante de órgãos, garantindo acesso integral, universal e gratuito para toda a população do país. Com a sua criação, o SUS proporcionou o acesso universal ao sistema público de saúde, sem discriminação. A atenção integral à saúde, e não somente aos cuidados assistenciais, passou a ser um direito de todos os brasileiros, desde a gestação e por toda a vida, com foco na saúde com qualidade de vida, visando a prevenção e a promoção da saúde. <div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Objetivo</h2><a id="user-content-objetivo" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Objetivo" href="#objetivo"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">O objetivo do projeto é criar uma API para organizar um sistema público de saúde.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Contextualização</h2><a id="user-content-contextualização" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Contextualização" href="#contextualização"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">O Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS) é um dos maiores e mais complexos sistemas de saúde pública do mundo, abrangendo desde o simples atendimento para avaliação da pressão arterial, por meio da Atenção Básica, até o transplante de órgãos, garantindo acesso integral, universal e gratuito para toda a população do país. Com a sua criação, o SUS proporcionou o acesso universal ao sistema público de saúde, sem discriminação. A atenção integral à saúde, e não somente aos cuidados assistenciais, passou a ser um direito de todos os brasileiros, desde a gestação e por toda a vida, com foco na saúde com qualidade de vida, visando a prevenção e a promoção da saúde. O objetivo desse projeto é criar uma ferramenta para auxiliar o SUS, evitar desperdício e potencializar os recursos a partir dos pacientes.</p>
<p dir="auto">Ao final do programa, além de apresentar a API criada, cada squad deverá expor quais são os pontos de melhoria e quais seriam os próximos passos no projeto, caso fossem seguir adiante.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Requisitos técnicos obrigatórios</h2><a id="user-content-requisitos-técnicos-obrigatórios" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Requisitos técnicos obrigatórios" href="#requisitos-técnicos-obrigatórios"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Para o projeto é necessário que as squads se utilizem dos aprendizados repassados pelo programa AceleraDev, portanto a solução deve ser construída de acordo com os seguintes requisitos:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Banco de dados;</li>
<li>Desenvolvimento do backend e APIs com Java Spring Boot;</li>
<li>Testes unitários são obrigatórios</li>
</ul>

<ul dir="auto">
<li>Todo hospital tem um estoque contendo diversos produtos.</li>
<li>Um estoque tem produtos e suas respectivas quantidades.</li>
<li>Dentro do estoque também tem banco de sangue</li>
<li>O hospital também possui leitos.</li>
<li>Ao encontrar um paciente é importante o recomendar para um hospital mais próximo e que tenha vaga disponível.</li>
<li>Caso o hospital precise de um produto, por exemplo, um banco de sangue, é importante fazer o envio do hospital mais próximo ao local.</li>
<li>Caso o hospital tenha apenas 4 itens ou 4 litros ele terá apenas o suficiente para o próprio hospital.</li>
</ul>

highLevelGoals: To quickly identify and be directed to the most suitable hospital with available beds based on their current location and needs.

To effectively monitor and manage the availability of hospital beds, ensuring efficient allocation for patient care.
To accurately track and manage the quantities of various products, including blood, within the hospital's stock.
To efficiently coordinate the transfer of necessary products, such as blood, from other hospitals while maintaining local minimum stock levels.
To oversee and optimize the utilization of all resources across the entire public health system to prevent waste and maximize efficiency.
To ensure that all hospitals maintain minimum required stock levels of essential products, especially blood, for immediate needs.
To coordinate and manage the strategic transfer of products between hospitals to meet system-wide demands and emergencies.
To gain a comprehensive overview of the health system's operational status, including bed availability and product inventories across all hospitals.

The Patient triggers the system to provide navigation instructions to the selected hospital.
The Patient confirms their pre-registered details upon arrival at the hospital to streamline the admission process.

The Hospital Staff modifies the total bed capacity for a specific ward within their hospital.
The Hospital Staff adjusts the count of currently occupied beds for a specific ward.
The Hospital Staff retrieves and displays the current bed availability status for all wards in their hospital.
The Hospital Staff updates the status of a specific bed to 'occupied' upon a patient's admission.
The Hospital Staff updates the status of a specific bed to 'available' after a patient's discharge.
The Hospital Staff registers a new type of product (e.g., blood type, medication) into the hospital's inventory system.
The Hospital Staff modifies the current quantity of a specific product in the hospital's inventory.
The Hospital Staff logs the consumption of a specific quantity of a product from the inventory.
The Hospital Staff retrieves and displays the current stock levels for all products in their hospital's inventory.
The Hospital Staff defines the minimum acceptable quantity for a specific product in their hospital's inventory.
The Hospital Staff initiates a request to another hospital for a specific product transfer.
The Hospital Staff reviews and approves a product transfer request received from another hospital.
The Hospital Staff reviews and rejects a product transfer request received from another hospital.
The Hospital Staff checks the current status of product transfer requests they have initiated to other hospitals.
The Hospital Staff retrieves a list of product transfer requests from other hospitals awaiting their review and action.
The Health System Administrator retrieves aggregated data on bed availability across all hospitals in the public health system.
The Health System Administrator retrieves aggregated data on product inventory levels across all hospitals in the public health system.
The Health System Administrator queries the system to find hospitals that have an excess of specific resources.
The Health System Administrator queries the system to find hospitals that are experiencing a shortage of specific resources.
The Health System Administrator defines the minimum required stock levels for critical products across all hospitals in the system.
The Health System Administrator queries the system to pinpoint hospitals whose stock of a critical product has fallen below the defined minimum level.
The Health System Administrator configures the system to receive automated notifications when a hospital's critical product stock falls below the minimum threshold.
The Health System Administrator commands the system to arrange a strategic transfer of products between specified hospitals.
The Health System Administrator reviews and approves a product transfer request that was initiated by a hospital.
The Health System Administrator retrieves a comprehensive record of all past and current system-wide product transfers.
The Health System Administrator temporarily bypasses a hospital's local minimum stock level to facilitate an urgent product transfer.
The Health System Administrator accesses a real-time visual dashboard displaying bed occupancy rates across all hospitals.
The Health System Administrator generates a report detailing the stock levels of critical products across all hospitals.
The Health System Administrator retrieves historical data to analyze trends in resource utilization over specified periods.
The Health System Administrator requests the generation of a report to aid in strategic capacity planning for a specific region or the entire system.

baselineCritiques.actors: The identified actors are generally appropriate for the described system. "Patient" covers the end-users receiving care, "Hospital Staff" covers the operational management of beds and inventory, and "Health System Administrator" covers the high-level coordination and oversight of the public health infrastructure. However, the description explicitly mentions "recommending the closest hospital... based on their location." This implies an interaction where a user (potentially a patient, a relative, or a triage operator) queries the system for recommendations. While "Patient" is listed, it is often ambiguous whether patients directly interact with the system or if it is done by staff. Given the "Hospital Staff" role is broad, it likely covers the operational side.
